reviews.title: I love it!
reviews.comment: I love this case! It is easy to open and easy to work with adding all of your preferred parts. It’s also easy to clean and customize.the color is perfect as well!
reviews.author: EEPW

reviews.title: Matcha Green!!!
reviews.comment: This was a birthday gift to myself for my gaming setup! I love the color and Thermaltake has fans and a liquid air color that match the Matcha green!  It’s girly without being too girly and I love it with all the matching pieces! It also fits perfectly on our setup and the cords go down the back so you don’t have to see them like with our old computers!
reviews.author: Jennifer
